task: Unified auto project creation and existing-project resolution

supersedes.status: superseded by final user auto-path requirements; prior 36 tests are not this implementation acceptance

behavior: New creation directory and existing-project path share automatic absolute-or-relative parsing for both native and Root identities.
Production Linux uses slash separators and lexical normalization of repeated slash, trailing slash, dot and parent segments; backslash, spaces and Windows-reserved names remain POSIX literals.
Relative paths are interpreted by the trusted helper under that identity nativeHome/projects; parent segments may leave this base. No identity-selected syntax branch or browser-supplied mode remains.
project/defaults returns only directory. resolve does not require an absolute caller path and never creates directories.

Relative creation retains default projects-root initialization; absolute creation does not initialize it. User-selected missing parents are never recursively created and existing paths are not overwritten.
Raw path UTF8/Unicode/control checks and normalized helper JSON 4096-byte budget run before creation beforeWrite. Root directory creation is explicitly rejected.
Definitive parent, permission and read-only filesystem errors remain not_sent with specific messages; failed parsing/readback after positive creation remains unknown.
Windows development fallback retains platform path behavior; production fixed launcher stays tied to the actual trusted execution identity with no automatic elevation.

coverage: Actual development filesystem create/write/read and normalized nested/parent relative paths
Absolute create leaves default root absent, missing/non-directory parents do not create side effects, existing files remain unchanged
Relative resolve reads existing sibling with absent default root and never creates a missing root
Mocked trusted native and Root launchers both receive normalized relative/absolute payloads and retain actual user identity
Both creation and read reject oversized escaped JSON before helper spawn; creation beforeWrite remains untouched
Long POSIX name acknowledgement and safe parent/permission/read-only error projection, malformed positive creation returns unknown

limitations: No full suite or live deployment was performed.

Actual Linux helper UID/permission and fsync behavior is covered by the deployment reviewer separately; this runtime test run uses real temporary development filesystem operations and controlled helper responses.
Original round2 audit remains bound to its old source digest and is not rebound to these feature changes.
